data.title: Stablecoin-to-Decentralized-Stablecoin Swap Velocity
data.description: Detects when a wallet receives USDT/USDC and swaps to decentralized stablecoins (DAI, sDAI, LUSD, RAI) via a DEX within 24 hours, particularly when the source wallet has elevated risk scores. The IRGC's documented USDT-to-DAI shift after mid-2025 Tether freezes is the direct intelligence basis. Centralized stablecoins can be frozen by issuers; swapping to decentralized alternatives defeats this control.
references: FATF Targeted Report on Stablecoins and Unhosted Wallets (March 2026)
falsepositives: DeFi yield farming strategies that routinely swap between stablecoin types
Institutional portfolio rebalancing across stablecoin allocations
Stablecoin arbitrage trading exploiting minor depegs
